data.title: 中野五月 · 甜品咖啡厅的巨型芭菲
data.description: 华丽典雅的法式甜品店内，巨大的草莓特制芭菲端上木桌。五月双手合十在胸前、双眼闪闪发亮地凝视着甜点，吃货少女的幸福感溢于言表。
data.action: hands together before meal, starry eyes, huge dessert parfait, overjoyed
data.promptProse: Seated in a cozy wooden cafe booth, Nakano Itsuki clasps her hands together with ecstatic sparkling eyes before a massive strawberry and cream dessert parfait. Her ahoge wiggles with sheer excitement, completely breaking her usual dignified composure.
data.animaCaption: Clasping her hands before a towering strawberry parfait, her eyes sparkle with uncontainable foodie joy.
